decisions.reason: The client permits shot-angle changes for set-image quality, creating a necessary exception to strict conformance with scripted shot direction while retaining the current script version.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text: So low angle shots are automatically low resolution? And higher angle shots can get better resolution? I'm ok with changing the angle on the shots to improve the quality of the set images. I didn't know that was a limitation.

value_updates.shot_angle_adjustment_for_quality: Shot angles may be changed when needed to improve set-image quality.

decisions.reason: The source permits angle adjustments for image quality but does not decide whether the distinct opening aerial establishing shot should be included.
